name: Vertiso Memory
description:
Vertiso Memory is a portable, user-owned memory layer for AI agents. Connect it once, and your assistant can capture and recall durable facts, decisions, preferences, and project context across every tool you use, rather than starting from scratch in each new conversation.

It exposes a small, composable toolset over MCP: remember to capture a durable fact, recall for hybrid search with synthesized answers, search for a ranked hybrid record lookup, and get_memory to inspect specific memories. Session tools like hello, handoff, and wrap-up let work continue cleanly across sessions and devices.

Your data is yours. We do not train AI models on your content. Memories are sent to third-party LLM providers solely for retrieval and synthesis, under those providers' standard no-training API terms, and are deletable upon request.

Works with any OAuth-capable MCP client. Connect by adding the server URL; client registration and sign-in happen in the browser, with no API key to paste.

Available worldwide except where prohibited by applicable law or unsupported by our service providers.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vertiso Memory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vertiso Memory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://memory.vertiso.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vertiso Memory MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vertiso Memory lists 14 MCP tools, including archive_memory, forget, get_memory, goodbye, handoff, handoff_resume, hello, list_recent, recall, remember, search, and unarchive_memory.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vertiso Memory?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Vertiso Memory in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Vertiso Memory MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vertiso Memory requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vertiso Memory is developed by Vertiso Corporation. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
